items.title: Share these readings with your care team
items.text: You should talk to your team about your readings, which were only in the target range 15.4% of the time. Your average reading was 211.5 mg/dL, so bring this up at your next visit.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after meals can be helpful, and a 10 to 19 minute walk got most of the gain with a 17.5 mg/dL difference. Walking after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: It's good that only 16.7% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, so keep it that way. Across the program, sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 8.2 hours, which is something to discuss with your team. In the program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed some numbers, but it's not clear how it affects everyone.
